verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents uploading custom model weights from Hugging Face, local files, S3 or Azure Blob, including via the REST API. It also documents serving LoRA adapters through live merge or multi-LoRA deployments created with a single firectl command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the upload and LoRA serving workflow, and evidence that adapters trained outside Fireworks can be uploaded (the LoRA docs frame them as Fireworks-trained models).

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Upload your own models from Hugging Face or elsewhere to deploy trained or custom-trained models optimized for your use case.
Upload from local files or directly from S3 buckets or Azure Blob Storage
Use the Fireworks REST API to upload custom models programmatically — ideal for automation, CI/CD pipelines, and notebooks.
Fireworks supports two deployment methods for LoRA trained models: live merge and multi-LoRA.
Base model is deployed with addon support; LoRA adapters are loaded dynamically at request time
